intent: R2dbcMemoryStoreTest runs the real V2 migration DDL on embedded H2 and asserts rows back with a UNIQUE session id per case: summary save and read by session and tenant, a foreign tenant gets nothing (SI-06 cross-owner), newest-first limit, overflow beyond keep, turnApplied, and the 16000-token CHECK refusal. PB-13: the pool maximum is read from spring.r2dbc.pool.max-size and equals 10.

methods.signature: Flux<ContextEntry> recentMessages(String sessionId, String tenantId, int limit)
Flux<ContextEntry> overflowMessages(String sessionId, String tenantId, int keep)
Mono<Boolean> turnApplied(String sessionId, String turnId, String tenantId)
methods.semantics: true when the turn was already applied for this session and tenant (duplicate, caller skips); false when not yet applied (caller proceeds)
